scope: Frozen E29/C seeds17/29, 288 development events each, same original Risk mask and Medium512 candidate panel. No new QKV, neural training, Test or KV probes. True page contributions reused, no exact attention regeneration.

At least one qualifying metric must also improve separately on BOTH dev trajectories for that seed. Report trajectory splits and concentration; do not accept an improvement solely on one trajectory. Only then execute B.

Distinct indices, nearest representative assignment with selection-order tie-break, weights=cluster_counts/64. Zero-size clusters allowed for duplicate vectors; no tuning. Only E29-Coreset16 and True-Coreset16 added, plus existing A comparisons.
